leadText:
A Stormy Time in the Battle Subway (Japanese: VS トルネロス・ボルトロス VS Tornadus & Thundurus), titled VS Tornadus / Thundurus in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 490th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 30th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Tornadus/Thundurus (Japanese: 風雷 Wind and Thunder) in the VIZ Media translation and A Stormy Time in the Battle Subway in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
